newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste rejoins CA bidding group-sources.
newsitem.headline: Erste rejoins CA bidding group-sources.

text.p: First Austrian savings bank is rejoining the consortium around insurer EA-Generali to bid for the state's stake in Creditanstalt-Bankverein, banking sources told Reuters on Tuesday.
Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank AG, or First Austrian, left the international consortium on September 6 following disagreement over the form their bid should take.

Sources said the consortium, which also includes Germany's Commerzbank and Italy's Banca Commerciale Italiana, on Monday voted unanimously, or with an overriding majority, for the return of First Austrian to the group.
Austrian media reported that only nine parties received the finance ministry's information memorandum after signing a declaration of confidentiality.
"There obviously aren't so many who're really interested (in Creditanstalt)," said one source.
The latest tender for the government's 70 percent voting stake closes on Friday.

The EA-Generali group in September bid around 6.7 billion schillings for roughly half the state's 19.9 million ordinary shares. But the Finance Ministry rejected the offer and restarted the sale, now in its seventh year.
